I really hope we get something out of the DDG deal. There's talk of Madrid offering us £20million for him.

We paid £20 million 4 seasons ago when he was an up and comer, it would be daylight robbery if we lost him for the same price now he's arguably in the top 3 keepers in the world.

How do you extract value for a player that wants to leave, won't sign a new deal and is in the last year of his contract? I don't think there is a way to do it, but I'd be interested to hear what people's thoughts on it are.

I don't think De Gea has behaved poorly here, for the record. From what I've read he's been open and honest with the club about what he wants and where his head is, and apparently he's still not entirely sure about the move to Real. But his ties to Madrid cannot be ignored when you consider what's happening.

I think he'll leave now/soon rather than see out his contract and I think we'll get a fee. I don't think it will be anywhere north of £25m, but with Madrid you never know. He's worth more of course, but as I said, with his contract the way it is it seems impossible to get what he's worth.

My biggest fear is that we re-enact the same awful situation we had after Schmeichel left. Some real duds signed, and we signed and rotated between a hell of a lot of average keepers until Ed VDS came along. The options are:

  • 1. Cech - I think he'll go to Arsenal, despite what Jose or anyone says. He'd rather keep his kids and family in London surely?
  • 1. Lloris - Solid enough keeper. Can be wonderful or dross, depending on the day. Dealing with Levy will be a nightmare though.
  • 1. Leno - Very very good young keeper. Couple of years younger than DDG, but arguably with the potential to be just as good.
  • 1. Valdes - Keep VV as #1 keeper. I'm not sure about him, but you cannot discount his experience, his attitude and his ability.He needs some adjustment time - which Leno will also require.

I think the safest bet would be Cech. Lloris is a no for me. I would love to try Leno and Valdes - but to have 2 inexperienced (in this league) keepers could be asking for trouble.

My knowledge of RBs is limited. Clyne and Coleman are the obvious choices from the PL, Carvajal is a name I've seen mentioned too. I just don't trust Tony's positioning when sides have a fluid attacking threat. He's always a few steps off the pace - which isn't his fault really. I wish Rafael could stay fit and LVG could work with him, but I think that ship has sailed unfortunately.

I just think it's a shame he won't sign a contract extension and then leave the next season so we can get a fee for him which would be fair. Kinda like what happened with Ronaldo and Suarez. It was obvious both of them were going to leave but they still signed an extension so the club which made them world class players get a fair fee.

My personal opinion on the keeper situation is buy Leno this Summer and start Valdes and #1 with Leno playing cup games (depending on his performance if he plays CL too). Then if Leno has proven himself he can be #1 for the 16/17 season. Valdes has proven he is a world class keeper and I think he would be a good stop gap for a season until we find someone younger/better but he is not a long term option.

I agree with you on the Rafa situation. I love watching him play and his attitude but it's pretty clear he won't be hear next season.
